fault: none: two jobs started at once on one object; the second call enters the object while the first job awaits the model, in work neither answer waited for, and its job reads the same total
description: An object answers a call and lets the job it kicked off finish after the answer, as an agent does. The job reads a running total, awaits an external model, and writes the total plus its steps. Two jobs started together both read the total before either writes it, and one job's steps are lost.
